name: GoodDollar GoodFundManager untrusted staking callback accounting
summary: GoodFundManager.collectInterest called arbitrary caller-supplied staking contracts and counted the reserve's cDAI growth across those calls as interest. A fake staking contract bought G$ from the reserve in the callback, so mintUBI booked the purchase again as interest and inflated the G$ price; selling G$ back drained the reserve.
notes: GoodReserveCDai.mintUBI trusts the starting balance its minter supplies; the defect is GoodFundManager measuring it across untrusted callbacks, so only GoodFundManager is a target. Both proxies were upgraded in the same transaction, so the age is the same either way.
The campaign transaction is the attacker EOA selling G$ from the anchor at the price the anchor had inflated, which drained the reserve's remaining cDAI.

Loss is the reserve's cDAI depletion; the G$ and G$X left with the attacker are newly minted claims, not victim assets. The earlier COMP sandwich through the same collectInterest is a different defect and a separate incident.
